title: AXP entitlement
description: An issuer's signed statement that one host (the holder, identified by its ed25519 host key) may use an extension (SPEC section 14.2). The only commerce object AXP defines: how the purchase happened is outside the protocol. Signed like a manifest — ed25519 over the JCS canonicalization with `signature` removed — by a key the issuer's key directory lists with role `entitlement`. Unknown fields are ignored.

holder.description: the host key (public form) this entitlement is bound to; the host proves possession in every presentation

serial.description: issuer-unique id; what renewal and revocation refer to

issuer.description: DNS name whose key directory lists signing.public_key with role entitlement; must be one of the manifest's commerce.issuers

valid_until.description: end of the right to use; null = perpetual

updates_until.description: releases published after this are not covered; null = every release

signature.description: base64 ed25519 signature over the canonical (JCS) document with signature removed
